---
name: Icon request
about: Suggest a new icon or a variant of an existing one
title: "Icon request: "
labels: icon request
---

**What should the icon mean?**
For example: “unlink”, “cloud upload”, “sort by date”.

**Where will it be used?**
The interface or context, and the icons that will stand next to it.

**References**
Similar icons in other sets (links), if any.

**Name**
A kebab-case name by what the icon depicts, for example `cloud-upload`.
